name: io.github.TheWhiteWater/tube-bridge
title: tube-bridge
description: YouTube MCP server for search, transcripts, frames, comments, channels, and local semantic corpora.

environmentVariables.name: YOUTUBE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional YouTube Data API v3 key for comments, channel tools, and higher-quality search.

environmentVariables.name: TUBE_BRIDGE_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP(S) or SOCKS proxy URL for yt-dlp and transcript requests.

environmentVariables.name: TUBE_BRIDGE_CACHE
environmentVariables.description: Optional directory for cache and corpus databases.
